gloss: to be hard work; to be laborious

definitions.gloss: to be hard work; to take great effort
definitions.explanation: Said of a task that demands great effort; literally 'the bones break.' {骨|ほね}の{折|お}れる{仕事|しごと} is a laborious job. The transitive {骨|ほね}を{折|お}る means to take pains, usually on someone else's behalf. The phrase can also be literal: to break a bone.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{骨|ほね}が{折|お}れる。
⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外国語|がいこくご}→外国語：03023_gaikokugo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{骨|ほね}が{折|お}れる。
examples.english: Learning a foreign language as an adult is laborious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{満足|まんぞく}している→満足する：22617_manzokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Reading and organizing all the old documents was laborious work, but I'm satisfied with the result.

notes:
Literally 'the bones break' under the effort. The literal sense, to break a bone, also exists; context decides.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {骨|ほね}が{折|お}れる⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ / ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: a laborious job
- {骨|ほね}が{折|お}れた: it was hard going

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{骨|ほね}を{折|お}る→骨を折る：17002_honewooru⟧: to take pains, to go to trouble for someone — the transitive pair, with a person's effort in view
- ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧: hard, tough — the plain word
- ⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to take time and effort — fiddly rather than strenuous
